name: Seated Lat Pulldown Machine
equipmentItems: Selectorized lat-pulldown machine with thigh pads
grip: Closed overhand grip slightly wider than shoulders, using the bar's comfortable angled sections.
description: Pull a high-cable bar toward the upper chest while seated with the thighs secured under the machine pads.
setup: Set the stack load and adjust the thigh pads to secure the legs without excessive pressure.
Grasp the bar, sit down with feet on the floor and establish a small stable backward incline.
Begin with arms reaching overhead and cable tension controlled.
instructions: Draw the elbows down toward the sides to bring the bar toward the upper chest.
Keep the torso angle stable rather than rocking backward.
Stop within a comfortable shoulder range, with the bar in front of the head.
Let the arms rise slowly and allow the shoulder blades to move naturally.
commonMistakes: Swinging the torso or pulling so low that the wrists and shoulders collapse.

logging.example: A single stack selected at 20 kg: record 20 kg on that machine.

variantNote: Assumes a selectorized high cable, wide overhand bar and thigh pads. A plate-loaded lever pulldown or independent handles requires a separate equipment variant.
